caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional statue of a human figure standing on a dark, tiered rectangular plinth. The figure is dressed in a colorful outfit with a deep blue top featuring puffed sleeves, gold collar and cuffs, and a circular medallion at the chest. The lower half of the outfit includes a red pleated skirt with a green hem, yellow belt, and decorative elements hanging from the waist. The figure’s legs are brown, with knee-high gold bands and brown shoes. The figure's arms are bent at the elbows, and the right arm is positioned downward while the left forearm is bent forward, resting on a rectangular structure beside the figure. The figure’s head is adorned with a headpiece in shades of brown, green, and pink. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with some faint marks or stains visible. No other objects are present in the composition.
